layers.title: Solar PV · simple climate profiles
layers.description: PV temperature is monthly-GHI-weighted ambient temperature, not module or cell temperature. Below 10 C is cool; above 25 C is hot; equality is mild. Provisional screening thresholds.
layers.warning: Experimental climate screening. Monthly averages do not describe extremes, battery life, optimal storage size or financial performance.

layers.title: Solar PV · ML climate groups
layers.description: New atlas MiniBatchKMeans model, fitted to area-weighted CRU/ERA5 climate features. Groups are described using their physical centres.
layers.warning: Experimental ML grouping. Spatial holdout diagnostics describe climate geometry; they do not prove better PV yield or battery performance.

layers.title: PV + battery · simple climate profiles

research.name: PVCZ · Photovoltaic Climate Zones
research.authors: Todd Karin, C. Birk Jones & Anubhav Jain
research.description: Degradation-oriented zones combine module equivalent temperature and specific humidity, with a separate wind class. GLDAS climate inputs cover 2010–2018 at 0.25°. This published product is imported unchanged in value; it is not a new GLDAS refresh.
research.availability: Includes the combined zone, rack/roof temperature zones, humidity zones and principal climate stressors. The catalogue links the original data and its MIT licence.

research.name: A machine learning approach to PV-climate classification
research.authors: Francisco Javier Triana de las Heras, Olindo Isabella & Malte Ruben Vogt
research.description: Cites KGPV and uses its simulated c-Si specific yield for comparison. Supervised feature selection followed by k-means yields 21 clusters from seven features, including mountainous climates. Climate inputs span 1991–2021 on a 0.5° grid.
research.availability: The paper states that location-to-zone data are in its supplement. The publisher supplement could not be retrieved here; no published cluster raster has been added. Supply the supplement to enable an exact import.

research.name: PVZones · Physics-guided machine learning
research.authors: Jabir Bin Jahangir & Muhammad Ashraful Alam
research.description: The open preprint cites the 2019 KGPV methodology as reference 17. Its PVZones map uses k-means (seven zones) with GHI, ambient temperature and clearness index to support representative sampling for PV yield prediction.
research.availability: The open preprint contains the map and methods, but no downloadable, georeferenced zone dataset was located in this search. The atlas does not infer zone cells from the printed figure.
